description.text: The sixth enhanced expansion pack of the Sword & Shield series, released on 25 February 2022, with many Pokémon of the Hisui region from the game Pokémon Legends: Arceus. Hisuian Typhlosion, Hisuian Decidueye and Hisuian Samurott appear as Pokémon VSTAR, with Starmie V and Garchomp V, a Dragon Pokémon without Weakness whose attack does 220 damage to any one of the opponent's Pokémon. It introduced Radiant Pokémon, marked K: shiny Basic Pokémon with strong attacks or Abilities, of which a deck may hold only one. Its three are Radiant Heatran, Radiant Greninja, whose Ability discards an Energy card from the hand to draw two cards, and Radiant Hawlucha. Each pack held six cards. The cards are numbered to 67, followed by six Character Rare Pokémon drawn with a Trainer, such as Roserade with Gardenia, full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, Character Super Rare Starmie V with Misty and Garchomp V with Cynthia, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VSTAR and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Hisuian Samurott VSTAR, Choice Belt and Jubilife Village. In English many of its cards came out in Astral Radiance in May 2022, and some in Lost Origin in September 2022.
